summary: Teaches setting up Grafana Database Observability for MySQL with Alloy and exploring query telemetry.

needs.description: MySQL 8.0+ (not MariaDB) with Performance Schema enabled and a monitoring user.
Machine running Alloy 1.17.0 or later with access to MySQL and Cloud.
Database Observability (grafana-dbo11y-app) activated on the stack.
Database Observability telemetry from the MySQL instance for Telemetry status tab and Queries overview.

reviewNotes: Telemetry-dependent steps can only be seeded by a live Alloy-to-MySQL pipeline.
